description: This file contains core event management, synchronization, and configuration constants for the Notesnook project, including event definitions, sync status functions, and date/time formats.

classes.name: EventManager
classes.description: Class managing event publishing and subscribing mechanisms.

methods.name: checkSyncStatus
methods.description: Checks the synchronization status for a given event type using the EventManager.

methods.name: sendSyncProgressEvent
methods.description: Publishes a synchronization progress event with current progress.

methods.name: sendMigrationProgressEvent
methods.description: Publishes a migration progress event with collection, total, and current progress.
